text: This staff report is about a matter that Community Council has delegated authority from City Council to make a final decision. Transportation Services has reviewed the need for an all-way stop control at the intersection of Janray Drive and Chandler Drive (north intersection). Based on the assessment undertaken, Transportation Services recommends the installation of an all-way stop control at Janray Drive and Chandler Drive (north intersection). The proposed all-way stop control will provide enhanced safety for all road users this intersection.
The Scarborough Community Council: 1. Approved the installation of compulsory stop control for northbound and southbound traffic on Janray Drive at Chandler Drive (north intersection).
